text:
PulseGrid is a fast-growing healthcare analytics startup building real-time insights for hospitals and clinics. We combine streaming data, machine learning signals, and human-centered dashboards to help care teams act faster. We move quickly, ship often, and value pragmatic engineering that scales.

What you'll do
- Design and build robust, low-latency backend services powering data ingestion, normalization, and API endpoints.
- Own and evolve REST APIs used by internal dashboards and third-party integrations; ensure high availability and clear versioning.
- Containerize services and manage CI/CD pipelines using Docker-based workflows.
- Collaborate with product, data, and frontend teams to translate requirements into reliable implementations and APIs.
- Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes and monitoring.

What we need (mandatory)
- 4-7 years of professional software engineering experience.
- Strong proficiency in Python.
- Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs.
- Practical experience with Docker for development and deployment.
- Proven ability to write clean, testable code and to operate services in production.
- Good communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams.

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- AWS
- Celery

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
